brief_rationale: The doctor recognized a high-risk post-coronary-intervention near-syncope/chest-tightness scenario and moved the family from waiting for outpatient results to calling 120. Core transfer safety, incomplete-result handling, medication-reconciliation boundaries, and family receipt were achieved, with EMS ultimately taking over. Two high-order points were completed: practical barrier navigation around refusal/waiting/self-transport and correction of the “recovered/normal partial labs means safe” misconception. No serious or minor responsibility-chain error is evident, so the trajectory meets Perfect.
